text: AI is changing how we build. Understanding why your code works still starts with the fundamentals.
Meet Gradient. A personal workspace for turning your next learning step into something you can build, test, and explain.
Start with thirty guided C plus plus lessons. Write something small. Check your understanding. Save the work that shows what you learned. One exercise. One clear next step.
Know what to read, what to practice, and what to check. Make space for focused work, then return to the ideas you want to remember.
As your foundation grows, connect practice to projects and organize your internship preparation. Build evidence of your thinking, one working result at a time.
Start without an account. Your progress stays in your browser. Transfer it with a JSON backup, and explore self-directed outlines when you are ready.
You do not need to learn everything today. You need a clear next step. A little direction. A lot of possibility. Start with Gradient.
